# Source-only bounded Optimal admission successor

These tables preserve every v5 selector, numeric loop, source/request identity
and historical column. New v6 columns classify the planned complete fresh
Optimal domain: source 64..16,384 inside its window, W10..16/H6..12/C6..12/S1..6,
minimum 3..7 and target <=4095. The independent pinned-preset resolver reconstructs
all 22 historical strategy-7 rows before applying source-aware bounds.

All 22 historical strategy-7 rows remain outside that bounded domain and change
from unsupported strategy to resource rejection. No historical success is lost
and no historical row is newly admitted. Explicitly bounded positive recipes
and actual default-level successes require separate successor interoperability
captures. This mapping is a prediction, not evidence that the public API has
been enabled. The original v5 data and all upstream selector inputs are unchanged.

Normal and optimized Python verify the identical complete inventory, fifteen
malformed-input controls, source/geometry boundary classifications and zero
child processes. `provenance.json` pins the predecessor files, resolver, preset
source, generator and every generated table.
